alibabacloud-agent-observability v0.0.1

- Initial release providing read-only analysis of user-supplied Agent trajectory data (trace_id) from Alibaba Cloud observability sources.
- Supports six core business scenarios: task review, failure diagnosis, latency analysis, consumption analysis (token-only), multi-Agent collaboration, and tool quality.
- Generates self-contained HTML observation reports combining insights from LoongSuit (CMS 2.0 Workspace) and eBPF (SLS Project) sources, with clear handling of any data gaps.
- Enforces strict read-only boundaries and requires all operations via a dedicated workflow script.
- CLI and environment variable configuration; requires user-specified region and at least one data source (SLS project or CMS workspace).
- Does not collect or select traces — only analyzes user-provided trace_id within a ≤4h time window.
